data.image_selection: first num_images images of the CIFAR10 test split in dataset order (deterministic -- shuffle=False, no DataLoader generator randomness)
data.normalization: standard CIFAR10 mean/std (src/utility/utils.py _norm); no augmentation (test transform: Resize -> ToTensor -> Normalize only, RandomCrop/Flip excluded)

estimator.probe_seed_reset: torch.manual_seed(probe_seed) immediately before every estimator call

basis.note: PTQ/QAT exist only fused+quantized, so fused is canonical for any PTQ/QAT comparison. FP32 is still traced in BOTH bases (fp32_unfused, fp32_fused) and the unfused->fused fusion_ratio is always reported alongside FP32 so nothing is hidden by the basis choice (see src/analysis/quant_induced_trace.py).
